Canonical visual identity: supplied CINNAMON FUZZBUTT MASTER SPRITE SOURCE SHEET and supplied CINNAMON ACTIONS SHEET (attached to the PDF). Artwork is clean illustrated 16-bit/SNES-inspired pixel-art with rich controlled stepped two-tone shading, smooth 1-3 px dark outlines at the final 64px sprite scale, expressive anatomy, consistent side-on orthographic game camera, a warm stone/sage lawn palette, campus navy #22477F and cream gold #EBC666, and rich mint green #A8EFAD only for shake items. No 3D mockups, cinematic photograph, generative blur, text hallucinations, watermark, UI screenshots or unrelated subjects. Cinnamon is a red panda, NEVER a fox, cat, or raccoon; his approved round black glasses, blue headband, gray shirt, olive cargo shorts, dark paws, oversized orange/black banded tail are immutable. Do not copy the Cinnamon design onto the Fox. University of Notre Dame campus has a recognizable Main Building and Golden Dome crowned with golden Marian statue, but the layout is deliberately game-fictional for legible platforming. No Bethel University. Gameplay contrast overrides photographic campus accuracy.

OUTPUT REQUEST: generate precisely ONE background art output for Dome parallax/landmark layer. Where it appears: dome. Subject/design: Side-scrolling picturesque Notre Dame Main Building on broad quad approach with golden cupola, symmetrical masonry facades, trees flanking without obstructing play. No playable ledges painted into backdrop.

RENDER AND EXPORT CONTRACT: source artwork composition 1920 x 1080 pixels, 1.778:1 aspect; exact cleaned game-ready PNG target 960 x 540 pixels, 1.778:1 aspect. Name output file exactly assets/production/dome/backgrounds/dm_bg01.png. Deliver one individual image file, not a collage or contact sheet, plus the raw source where available. Pixel scale is a post-process target: if the generator cannot guarantee pixel-exact output, supply a high-resolution source and flag the need for deterministic resize and manual QA rather than claiming a compliant file.

TRANSPARENCY: opaque RGB, full bleed, no fake transparent grid; seamless clear edges with no border. A fixed solid matte is only a rejected-source recovery path, never described as final alpha.

REQUIRED SOURCE VISUALS: assets/references/cinnamon_master_sheet.png, assets/references/cinnamon_actions_sheet.png. Both sheet images are provided at the start of this PDF for style authority.
